about: Trait vocabulary for the sameness detector. Each finished game gets one value per trait. A trait with roll=null has no dice behind it, so any repetition is an accident of habit and a candidate for a new roll axis.

primary_bucket.about: What the primary tracked number is, the thing the player spends and fights over.
primary_bucket.hint: The CURRENCY roll now exists. Check that the next games obey it.

tracked_count.about: How many numbers the status line tracks (not counting the turn counter).
tracked_count.hint: The TRACKED roll (1 to 3) now sets this. Check that games obey it.

rival_type.about: How the main opposing force behaves.

meaning.marcher: moves by a fixed route or stride
meaning.counter: reacts to the player's last move
meaning.racer: races the player on a shared tally
meaning.hunter: targets the richest or weakest thing

rival_tell.about: When the player learns what the rival will do.
rival_tell.hint: Add a roll axis TELL: before, after, or hidden (inferred from history). Today the pre-flight rule makes every tell arrive before the player acts.

meaning.deadline: an event lands on turn N

opening_shape.about: What the first third of turns feels like.

meaning.flat: outcome effectively settled 3 or more turns early; the rest is routine
meaning.final-roll: decided by one decisive late roll or check
meaning.photo-finish: margin of one or two, decided by the player's last choices
meaning.collapse: player lost control late after leading

ending_shape.hint: Rolled as FINISH (d4: final-roll, photo-finish, collapse, cliff; never flat). The generator designs the last third for the rolled shape; profile and autopsy verify it. A flat ending with a FINISH roll behind it is BENT.

player_frame.about: What the player is doing, structurally.

meaning.operator: drives one machine, route or crew

player_frame.hint: ROLE is bent into the same frame. Add a ROLE-to-frame map so the table decides the frame and the generator does not override it.

meaning.pick-action: choose one action from a short list
meaning.place: put a piece on a board

decision_unit.hint: The engine contract offers a fixed list of options, so bids, allocations, placements and routes collapse into menu picks whatever FORM rolls. Add parametric actions: an option may carry a number range or a target the player fills in.

turn_band.about: Turn budget: short is 14 or fewer, mid is 15 to 18, long is 19 or more.
